questions.question: A psalm writer says his soul clings to the dust and asks God to revive him according to His word. True or false?
A psalm writer asks God to remove him from the path of deceit. Which way does he say he has chosen?
A psalm writer asks for God's loving devotion and salvation to come to him. What does he say he will then be able to do?

answers.text: Answer the one who taunts him
Rest from all of his labor
Rebuild the walls of his city

questions.question: A psalm writer says he will speak of God's testimonies before kings. True or false?
